scope: Keep authenticated Publish 14.1 combat and Combat Medic damage-over-time effects under classic potency, dissipation, and absorption authority without allowing inherited NGE expertise, vulnerability, armor, generic damage, or repeat pulse-resistance layers to modify them.

findings: Publish 14.1 applies authored DOT strength after an application resistance check, reduces duration through the matching dissipation skill modifier, and reduces each pulse through the matching classic absorption modifier capped at 50 percent.

The pinned Publish 14.1 implementation has no NGE DOT-increase expertise, DOT vulnerability, all-DOT expertise absorption, armor-derived DOT mitigation, generic multiply/divide-damage modifiers, or second resistance roll on every pulse.
The inherited shared DOT library contained all of those later layers and was reachable from authenticated PRE-CU combat actions and restored Combat Medic poison/disease medicine.
Later quests, expansion zones, space content, and other compatibility callers continue to use the inherited DOT path; PRE-CU authority is persisted per DOT instance and survives its pulse schedule.
